Moodles_SlowBurnHidden_Good_desc_lvl4: You walk invisible among the dead. Your infected blood runs cold, masking all signs of life from hungry eyes.
Moodles_SlowBurnHunted_Bad_desc_lvl1: The zombies know you don't belong. They're actively searching for you, following your scent and sound. Stay mobile and avoid large groups.
Moodles_SlowBurnHunted_Bad_desc_lvl2: You've become the primary target of the local zombie pack. They coordinate their search, closing in from multiple directions.
Moodles_SlowBurnHunted_Bad_desc_lvl3: The undead pursue you with single-minded determination. Your living scent drives them into a hunting frenzy.
Moodles_SlowBurnHunted_Bad_desc_lvl4: You are marked prey. Every zombie in the area knows exactly what you are and where to find you.
Moodles_SlowBurnInfected_Good_desc_lvl1: The infection courses through your veins, but you maintain control. Temperature: ~37.2°C
Moodles_SlowBurnInfected_Good_desc_lvl2: You've found balance with the virus. It's part of you now. Temperature: ~37.2°C
Moodles_SlowBurnInfected_Good_desc_lvl3: The fever is manageable. You're walking the line between human and infected. Temperature: ~37.3°C
Moodles_SlowBurnInfected_Good_desc_lvl4: You and the infection have reached an understanding. For now. Temperature: ~37.4°C
Moodles_SlowBurnMild_Bad_desc_lvl1: A slight warmth spreads through your body. The infection is stirring. Temperature: ~38.0°C
Moodles_SlowBurnMild_Bad_desc_lvl2: Your temperature is rising. You feel flushed and slightly uncomfortable. Temperature: ~38.3°C
Moodles_SlowBurnMild_Bad_desc_lvl3: The fever is building. Your skin feels hot to the touch. Temperature: ~38.6°C
Moodles_SlowBurnMild_Bad_desc_lvl4: You're definitely running a fever now. Time to find some medicine. Temperature: ~38.9°C
Moodles_SlowBurnModerate_Bad_desc_lvl1: The fever is becoming worrisome. You feel weak and dizzy. Temperature: ~39.0°C
Moodles_SlowBurnModerate_Bad_desc_lvl2: Your body burns with fever. Sweat beads on your forehead. Temperature: ~39.3°C
Moodles_SlowBurnModerate_Bad_desc_lvl3: The fever is dangerous now. Your vision occasionally blurs. Temperature: ~39.6°C
Moodles_SlowBurnModerate_Bad_desc_lvl4: You're burning up from the inside. Every breath feels like fire. Temperature: ~39.9°C
Moodles_SlowBurnSevere_Bad_desc_lvl1: The fever is severe. You struggle to think clearly. Temperature: ~40.0°C
Moodles_SlowBurnSevere_Bad_desc_lvl2: Delirium sets in. Reality blurs at the edges. Temperature: ~40.3°C
Moodles_SlowBurnSevere_Bad_desc_lvl3: You see things that aren't there. The fever is cooking your brain. Temperature: ~40.6°C
Moodles_SlowBurnSevere_Bad_desc_lvl4: You can barely stand. The world spins around you. Temperature: ~40.9°C
Moodles_SlowBurnSuspicious_Bad_desc_lvl1: Some zombies are starting to take notice. Your recent actions have made you stand out from the horde. Be more careful with loud noises and sudden movements.
Moodles_SlowBurnSuspicious_Bad_desc_lvl2: Several zombies have begun to eye you with growing curiosity. Your behavior is becoming suspicious to the undead masses.
Moodles_SlowBurnSuspicious_Bad_desc_lvl3: You're no longer just another face in the crowd. Zombies are starting to sense something different about you.
Moodles_SlowBurnSuspicious_Bad_desc_lvl4: The horde has marked you as different. Several zombies track your movements with growing interest.
